Rule for the tree to the leaves (J 22:18), logged before the script runs. Weighting and tree: D4a-08c's exactly (the same construction, recomputed; the six-form membership of all 705 rooms must equal room-forms-D4a08c.jsonl, else stop). (1) The 558 defining rooms: the Ward tree as built, undone merge by merge from the top, so each cut k holds k groups of defining rooms; the six groups at k = 6 are the forms A to F. (2) Placed rooms, as placed at six and then the same rule below: a thin room stays in its six-form and at each split below goes to the child whose centre (mean of its defining rooms) its whole mix is nearer; a core room the same with the code part only; down to the one defining room it reaches. Above six, each room takes the merged form that holds its form, so every room's labels nest. (3) Labels: k < 6 the merged letters (B+C); k = 6 the letter; below, a split child takes its parent's label plus .1 (the larger) or .2. (4) Files: the drawable tree over all 705 rooms, each placed room hanging from the room it reached at its distance to it (the placing distance), capped at the height where that room's branch joins the tree so that heights never fall going up, the cap counted; out/room-forms-tree.nwk, out/room-forms-tree-linkage.tsv (merge order, children, height, rooms, kind, label, the cuts at which the node is a group), out/room-forms-tree-rooms.tsv (every room's form and label at k = 4 to 30, its full address down to its leaf, how placed). (5) Checks: the six forms against D4a08c; the cuts against fcluster; the full linkage valid and monotone; the nested labels at four and eight against the D4a08c tsv, whose placed rooms were placed at each count on their own, differences counted. Not a move: the splits below the forms are not named or declared (J: they need not be justified or named); the tree is a view.
